FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our IT service and support offerings.

FAQcard.title: What response time can I expect for support tickets?
FAQcard.description: Our standard SLA is 4-hour response for non-critical issues and 1-hour for critical issues. We also offer 24/7 emergency support for clients on premium plans.

FAQcard.title: Do you offer on-site IT support?
FAQcard.description: Yes. For businesses in our service areas, we offer on-site support for hardware issues, network setup, and infrastructure work that can't be resolved remotely.

FAQcard.title: Can you manage our existing hosting and servers?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We can take over management of your existing infrastructure whether it's on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, or traditional hosting providers.

FAQcard.title: How do you handle website emergencies?
FAQcard.description: We have a dedicated emergency response process. If your website goes down or gets hacked, our team mobilizes immediately to diagnose and resolve the issue — minimizing your downtime and data risk.

FAQcard.title: Do you offer monthly retainer plans?
FAQcard.description: Yes. We offer flexible monthly retainer packages based on your support needs, from basic website maintenance to full managed IT services. All plans include regular reporting and priority support.
